title: Sikkimese Bhutia language
description: Tibetic language of Nepal and India
extract: The Sikkimese Bhutia language is a Sino-Tibetan language spoken by the Bhutia people of the Indian state of Sikkim and parts of Koshi province in eastern Nepal, and Bhutan. It is one of the official languages of Sikkim.
